title: dactylorhiza × kuehnensis subsp. kuuskiae
intro: Dactylorhiza × kuehnensis subsp. kuuskiae, commonly known as the Kuusamo-spotted orchid, is a hybrid orchid species that belongs to the Dactylorhiza genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × kuehnensis subsp. kuuskiae include vasodilation, diuretic effects, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its medicinal properties and to standardize its use in traditional medicine.
